sentences: The source title concerns finding three disjoint paths while also optimizing their lengths.
Even a fixed number of routes can compete for the same useful vertices or edges.
Length minimization adds a global optimization requirement to the feasibility of routing all three connections.
A satisfactory complexity result would clarify whether that extra requirement fundamentally changes the tractability of a small routing instance.
